The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9c819fab2884b68b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. statement: Under either compact spectral condition above, the following extensions hold. (i) If f is continuous and |f(z)|/(1 + z2) → 0 as |z| → ∞, the pressure converges in probability to the final bounded-cutoff limit of the main formula. Convergence in mean also holds, for example, if the spectra are uniformly bounded by a deterministic constant. (ii) If f is bounded Borel and ν ̸= δ0, the pressure converges in probability and in mean. Its value is a final uniformly bounded continuous approximation limit, with approximation in Lebesgue measure on compact intervals as in the proof.
